description: This file contains overrides and extensions for Drupal's core tabledrag functionality, specifically tailored for the Claro theme. It refactors table row markup for better label wrapping, adds visual markers for changed rows, manages indentation movement, and provides UI components for table row weights and drag handles.

methods.name: createItemWrapBoundaries
methods.description: Refactors table row markup to improve label wrapping by wrapping the first cell's content and moving the handle into a specific wrapper.

methods.name: markChanged
methods.description: Adds a visual marker to indicate a changed row.

methods.name: onIndent
methods.description: Moves indent elements into Claro's wrapper after an indent is added.

methods.name: tableDragIndentation
methods.description: Constructs the markup for the indentation indicator.

methods.name: tableDragChangedWarning
methods.description: Constructs the markup for the warning shown when there are unsaved changes.

methods.name: tableDragHandle
methods.description: Constructs the HTML for the table drag handle.

methods.name: tableDragToggle
methods.description: Constructs the HTML for the toggle button to show/hide row weights.

methods.name: toggleButtonContent
methods.description: Constructs the content for the toggle button based on whether weights are shown.

methods.name: tableDragCellContentWrapper
methods.description: Constructs the wrapper for the initial content of a drag cell.

methods.name: tableDragCellItemsWrapper
methods.description: Constructs the wrapper for the entire drag cell.
